cover.coreProposition: Permission authority should follow the attachment/runtime lifecycle it governs: resolve and publish authority per server, reject unresolved authority, and let refresh replace only the owning scope rather than a broad shared manager.
cover.visualMetaphor: Several shared ports, each carrying its own distinct authorization seal
cover.semanticObject: A central resource identity connected to scoped permission seals without merging them
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with precise modular forms, isolated authority colors and restrained depth
